en.title: 2026 Federal Tax Brackets Overview
en.description: Comprehensive guide to 2026 IRS federal tax brackets, standard deduction changes, and inflation adjustments.
en.intro: The IRS has announced annual inflation adjustments for the tax year 2026. These changes prevent 'bracket creep' and may result in lower taxes for filers whose income has not increased significantly.
en.details:
• Standard Deduction (Single): Projected to increase to approximately $16,100.
  • Standard Deduction (Married): Projected to increase to approximately $32,200.
  • Top Tax Rate: Remains at 37% for the highest income bracket.

The 2026 tax year generally corresponds to tax returns filed in early 2027.
